note: Data carriers (src/game/DataTraffic.ts): vehicles that drive only for real data. Plain text for players; facts from the linked docs.

tanker.name: Replication tanker
tanker.simple: Carries a copy of your data to another Region, so a second copy is ready if one Region has trouble.
tanker.more: Cross-Region replication (for example DynamoDB global tables or S3 Replication) copies changes to another Region, usually within seconds. Data sent to another Region is billed as data transfer out.

armoured.name: Standby van
armoured.simple: Keeps a spare copy of your database in another Availability Zone, ready to take over if the first fails.
armoured.more: A Multi-AZ database writes every change to a standby in a second AZ (synchronous replication). If the primary fails, Amazon RDS fails over to the standby. This replication isn't billed as data transfer.

request.name: Request car
request.simple: One of your users' requests driving in, shared out to a server in one of the Availability Zones.
request.more: A load balancer spreads incoming requests across healthy targets in the Availability Zones you enabled, so one AZ failing doesn't stop your app.

courier.name: Agent courier
courier.simple: An agent's call to another service, carried across town. Tap a building to see what it does with it.
courier.more: Each call is one real AWS API request the agent makes for you (shown as it happens), and only after you approve anything that changes your account.
